title: Design: Credit Hold banner with a long payer name keeps Change Bill To visible
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Credit Hold credit term, with a long name with no spaces that no other customer has, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, a second payer, on the Credit Hold credit term, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer C.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p3-14-after-banner.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A; customer A is on COD, so the banner is about customer B.
  • The Credit Hold banner reads "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer B's name], is on Credit Hold"
  • The banner text stays inside the banner: no part of it runs past the right edge of the window or covers "Change Bill To".
  • The "Change Bill To" button is fully visible.

Step 2:

  • The Credit Hold banner reads "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer C's name], is on Credit Hold"
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.
  • The "Change Bill To" button is fully visible.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R6: “If the Bill To is on Credit Hold, the Credit Hold banner reads M2 with a "Change Bill To" button (work orders: page header; part sales: Finance tab).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “M2 | Create Invoice when the Bill To is on Credit Hold | "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [Bill To], is on Credit Hold" | Banner with "Change Bill To"; Create Invoice tooltip; error toast with "Change Bill To"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Banner" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-14-after-banner.png

The design's own words:

  • “Banner: "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair, is on Credit Hold", with "Change Bill To".”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
